settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We currently ship within Canada. Rates and delivery estimates are calculated at checkout. See our shipping policy.

settings.question: Why can't some fragrances ship by air?
settings.answer: Fragrances contain alcohol and may be regulated as dangerous goods. Some orders therefore ship by ground, which can take longer to remote regions.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: For hygiene reasons, opened fragrances may not be returnable. Please read our refund policy for full details.

settings.question: Can I add a gift message?
settings.answer: Yes — open your bag and add a gift message or order note before checkout.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Your shipping confirmation email contains a tracking link. You can also sign in to your account to view your orders.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Payments are processed securely by Shopify. Available methods are shown at checkout.

settings.text: Our team is happy to help you find a fragrance or answer a question about your order.
